svg.title: PangoLock: zero-knowledge folder vault for macOS
svg.desc: Hero project card. A rotating armored planet with golden rings represents PangoLock, a zero-knowledge folder vault for macOS written in Swift and SwiftUI, MIT licensed, version 0.2.1. A relay of satellites animates the key flow: master password, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 210,000 iterations, master key checked by a verifier, HKDF-SHA256 per-item key, AES-256-GCM encryption, uuid.plock atomic write, decrypt and compare (verify before delete), original removed, locked. Also: Keychain and Touch ID, crash-window tests, 87 XCTest tests, CI on macOS, a written threat model, recovery key, portable lockers, encrypted sharing.
